paragraphs: A React + TypeScript billing workspace with an Express/Mongoose backend, admin login, buyer price lists and invoice history. Products, buyers, prices and sales are stored in MongoDB; local drafts and seller settings remain in the browser. See UPGRADE.md for configuration, APIs, migration and verification details.
features: Admin login, buyer master, buyer-specific product/variant prices and filtered sales history.
Editable buyer, seller, bank and invoice details.
Searchable, category-filtered product picker with batch selection, decimal quantities, Escape, arrow-key navigation and F7 to add selected products.
Create, edit and delete catalogue products. Item code and barcode uniqueness checks.
USB/Bluetooth keyboard-style scanner support: focus the code input, scan and press Enter. SKU and barcode matching are case-insensitive.
